undying.line: Limitless undying love, which shines around me like a million suns
undying.lineNext: It calls me on and on and on across the universe
stanza: Sounds of laughter, shades of life
Are ringing through my open ears
Inciting and inviting me
Limitless undying love, which shines around me like a million suns
It calls me on and on and on across the universe

And as for my inflammatory writ?
Well, I wrote it and I was not inflamed one bit
Advice from the master derailed that disaster;
He said "Hand that pen over to me, poetaster!"
While across the great plains
Keening lovely & awful
Ululate the lost Great American Novels —
An unlawful lot, left to stutter and freeze, floodlit
(But at least they didn't run
To their undying credit.)

undying.line: Come a little piece of the Lord's undying light
undying.lineNext: Crying like he swallowed the fiery moon
stanza: Well, now on a summer night
In a dusky room
Come a little piece of the Lord's undying light
Crying like he swallowed the fiery moon
Well, in his mother's arms
It was all the beauty I could take
Like the missing words to some prayer
Oh, that I could never make, oh
